headline: US will hold off on Iran power plant strikes for 5 days, extending Trump deadline on Hormuz strait
summary: Trump extended his deadline for Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and said the US will hold off on power plant strikes for five days. The strait is a key route for global oil shipments.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of seaborne oil, so disruptions there move crude prices and energy-importing economies.
why_moved: The extended deadline keeps uncertainty over reopening the Strait of Hormuz, a key oil transit route, and the threat of power plant strikes remains.
